import json, random, sys, importlib.util, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import fuzz
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("subm", "/app/submission/main.py")
subm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(subm)
dec = collections.Counter(); st = collections.Counter()
for seed in range(2000, 2800):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    doc = fuzz.gen(rng)
    got = subm._run(json.dumps(doc).encode())
    for p in got["packets"]: dec[p["decision"]] += 1
    for j in got["jobs"]: st[j["status"]] += 1
print("decisions:", dict(dec))
print("statuses:", dict(st))
